goal: Complete persistent discharge-log first version through board smoke; no full discharge started

decisions.stop_basis: Fresh raw voltage, not old percent or cell cutoff
decisions.proposed_3400_mv: Only after separate staged low-voltage runtime/save validation; not active in this version
decisions.source_percent: Uncalibrated pinned SDK Huangshan reference, not our cell measurements

implementation.format: Explicit probe and full blank scan; never on mount failure
implementation.low_stop: UI-thread flashlight brightness zero/OFF latch, cleared only by valid USB; not system poweroff
implementation.flash_coordination: CycleLog-only PREV recursive gate wrapping cross-object rt_flash_read/write/erase; not all same-TU debug/OTP/ROM paths
implementation.sdk_wait: Operation count bounded, SDK busy loops/semaphore not hard-time-bounded; no forced release while call active
implementation.export: Strict row/page/session/order/CRC + before/after whole-file manifest, shared20min deadline, BIN and UTF-8 CSV
implementation.rtc: UTC validity separately encoded; monotonic elapsed always used

fixes: Always close/reload/verify prefix after append or final sync errors
Reserve END queue and row slots
Preserve inhibit latch after false load observation
Age worker stale rows from current enqueue time
Export explicit session binding and shared total deadline

hardware.first_smoke_no_file_created: Inference from qualification before create, not independent absence query

limitations: USB smoke not FULL-to-discharge/fixed flashlight/real3600mV cutoff or low voltage save validation
No physical power loss/interrupted-write, wear/cache/current/lifetime proof
SDK busy wait has no hard timeout; only dedicated white-listed operator window admitted
Current ordinary firmware excludes logger; FS and smoke file retained. One cycle file cannot be overwritten for a new run
Boot and cumulative scene counters remain in separate old runtime; row elapsed does not cross boots
Up to four-row batch tail may be absent after sudden power loss, terminal=false indicates incomplete prefix
next_bounded_step: Separate pure-battery/fixed-load/protection-stop validation window before staged3400mV admission or full discharge. No automatic device actions.
